That is an amateur way of doing it. The professional approach is to do it all at once. Below is a dataframe showing a Polars function I covered each day in my [100DaysOfPolars](https://www.conterval.com/blog/#category=100DaysOfPolars). ```py import polars as pl pl.read_csv('days_data') ``` ::: {#6682b5c1 .cell execution_count=1} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ## Assign data type on read To assign a different data type to a column while reading a CSV file, use the option `schema_overrides` like this: ```py pl.read_csv('days_data.csv', schema_overrides={'Day_Count': pl.String}) ``` ::: {#5527242f .cell execution_count=2} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
